document.summary: Software and AI Engineer with over 2 years of experience developing robust data pipelines, scalable backend integrations, and mobile architectures. Proven expertise across batch ETL/ELT orchestration, local LLM systems, and high-performance Flutter applications.

roles.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Architected custom Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) endpoints in Spring Boot to accelerate mobile API integration, reducing integration time by 40% and unblocking parallel development cycles.
Shipped a full-stack sports management platform, managing mobile client releases to the App Store and Google Play while coordinating real-time backend synchronization.
Spearheaded refactoring legacy code to Riverpod and GoRouter, eliminating 90% of critical bugs on core flows and reducing app size by 15%.
Engineered 10+ custom Flutter screens and established a unit/widget testing culture achieving ~80% code coverage.

roles.title: AI Engineer (Graduation Project)
bullets: Designed a privacy-first resume parsing engine using a local Mistral LLM, replacing external APIs to guarantee data confidentiality and cut operational costs.
Programmed an AI pre-screen interview system using Whisper (STT) and Google TTS to conduct real-time automated candidate assessments.
Dockerized the multi-model pipeline, creating reproducible container images to streamline local execution and deployment.

roles.title: Mobile Developer
bullets: Engineered the frontend architecture for "Lovester", delivering fluid 60fps animations across 25+ unique application screens.
Migrated architecture from Provider to Riverpod and built testing pipelines, cutting regression bugs by 20%.

roles.title: AI Mobile Developer Intern
bullets: Built "Voltisense," an IoT mobile app visualizing household energy metrics via sub-second MQTT streaming.
Secured 2nd place out of 20+ teams in the Orange Summer Challenge through end-to-end model-to-mobile prototype delivery.

projects.name: FPL Batch Data Lakehouse
projects.label: Personal Project
bullets: Built an end-to-end local lakehouse ingesting 5 seasons (~140K+ records) of Premier League data into LocalStack S3, with idempotent, retry-safe Python pipelines handling schema drift automatically.
Designed a dbt star schema on DuckDB with custom entity resolution reconciling ~2,000 player identities across disparate schemas, achieving 10/10 passing tests across 4 resolved collision classes.
Orchestrated full ingest-to-transform pipelines using dependency-chained Airflow DAGs within Docker Compose.
